title: 6.7 Simple Requests
unit_outcome: Ask where a familiar place is, understand simple directions, and use familiar transportation and schedule language.
goal: Ask politely for basic help and respond with a short known location answer.
grammar_function: Memorized request-response sequence: Excuse me. Can you help me? Yes. Where is...? It is... Thank you.
prerequisite: 5.8 polite chunks; 6.3 where questions; 6.4 location words; 6.6 can.
speaking_outcome: Say excuse me, ask for help, ask where the station is, give one location answer, and close politely.
